evals.name: commit-only
evals.prompt: Commit these finished changes locally; do not push or open a PR.
evals.expected_output: Runs final artifact inventory and read-back, then project quality gate, inspects diff, stages named files only, creates a Conventional Commit, verifies status, and stops without asking PR layout or publishing.

evals.name: cohesive-single-auto-selection
evals.prompt: Open a PR for this finished, cohesive feature and its tests.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes one cohesive review unit, selects a single PR, and proceeds without asking topology, including under auto.

evals.name: stack-recommendation-choice
evals.prompt: Open a PR for a change with a shared protocol layer, dependent implementation, and final wiring.
evals.expected_output: Names the independently reviewable ordered layers, decides stacked_linear without asking, and states the decision as one 'Plated as' line before any commit or branch-layout mutation.

evals.name: explicit-single-authoritative
evals.prompt: Plate this as one PR.
evals.expected_output: Treats the explicit single-PR choice as authoritative, decides without asking, then runs durable-write and quality gates, commits named files, pushes, creates with explicit base/head and --body-file, and verifies via gh pr view.

evals.name: ambiguous-review-shape
evals.prompt: Open a PR for this finished branch; the changes share a goal but may form separable layers.
evals.expected_output: Weighs the cohesion and layer evidence, decides single unless clean commit or whole-file boundaries exist, and records the reason in one line without asking the user.

evals.name: pr-plan-cannot-override-explicit-choice
evals.prompt: Use one PR. A supplied pr_plan recommends a stack.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the explicit single-PR choice, decides without asking, and treats the plan only as non-authoritative review-shape evidence.

evals.name: existing-pr-no-choice
evals.prompt: Push these fixes to the PR already open for this branch.
evals.expected_output: Does not ask layout. Detects ordinary versus stack metadata, commits safely, then uses the matching update path and verifies the PR.

evals.name: write-failure-halts
evals.prompt: Open a PR, but the promised ADR write fails read-back.
evals.expected_output: Halts before just check, staging, commit, push, or PR creation; reports a {target, backend, verified:false} completion row.

evals.name: hallouminate-fallback
evals.prompt: Publish this repo; hallouminate is unavailable and the implementation made a durable design decision.
evals.expected_output: Writes and reads back a tracked docs/adr fallback, includes it in the commit, and does not hand-edit a wiki.

evals.name: graphite-post-merge
evals.prompt: The bottom Graphite PR merged. Sync and republish the remaining stack.
evals.expected_output: Uses gt sync, gt log short, and gt submit --stack; never bare rebase or single-branch push.

evals.name: git-town-post-merge
evals.prompt: The bottom Git Town PR merged. Catch up the rest.
evals.expected_output: Uses git town sync --stack and git town branch. Conflict recovery uses git town continue/skip, not bare git rebase continuation.

evals.name: gh-stack-post-merge
evals.prompt: The bottom gh stack PR merged. What should happen locally?
evals.expected_output: Uses gh stack sync to pull server-cascaded state and gh stack view; submits only for unpublished local commits.

evals.name: stack-without-boundaries
evals.prompt: Make this a stack.
evals.expected_output: Honors the stack choice and derives layer boundaries from existing commits or whole files without asking; when no clean boundary exists, it collapses to single and states why instead of inventing boundaries.

evals.name: gh-stack-not-enabled
evals.prompt: Publish this as a stack. gh-stack is the only installed provider and its repository preflight answers 404.
evals.expected_output: Reads the stack-tools gh-stack status not-enabled from the read-only repos/{owner}/{repo}/stacks preflight, halts before any stack mutation, and reports the repository-enablement requirement rather than retrying or emulating a stack with plain pushes.

evals.name: gh-stack-preflight-auth-failure
evals.prompt: Publish this as a gh-stack stack; the enablement preflight answers 401.
evals.expected_output: Reports an authentication failure, not a repository-enablement requirement, and does not treat the non-200 response as proof that Stacked PRs is disabled.

evals.name: hard-final-state
evals.prompt: Plate --hard and open a PR.
evals.expected_output: Runs final writing gate and validation before giving hard-cheese the final artifact inventory and completion rows, then publishes only if the gate passes.

evals.name: malformed-durable-write
evals.prompt: Plate this work. The durable ADR write was rejected: the replace_text op carried start and end line numbers alongside old and new.
evals.expected_output: Halts at the durable write step, names the failure plate-owned because replace_text carries only old and new and never start/end, then re-runs the canonical sequence for that file — fresh tagged read, one stale-safe write with the corrected op shape, diff read-back — instead of reporting a backend outage, retrying the stale tag, or falling back to a shell redirect or host editor.

evals.name: review-surface-request
evals.prompt: Plate this branch and tell me whether the diff is safe to merge.
evals.expected_output: Halts at classify and names the failure plate-owned: the review judgment is /age's, not /plate's, so it never computes a review surface for its own sake. Reports the routing and either proceeds with the publication half alone or stops for the user to route the review, never blending a quality verdict into the completion record.

evals.name: gh-stack-warning-only-failure
evals.prompt: gh stack submit exited zero but warned that it failed to update the stack on GitHub. Is publication complete?
evals.expected_output: Treats the warning as publication failure, preserves the command output, and does not report completion until gh-stack-verify confirms every PR base, head, state, SHA, and remote stack mapping.

evals.name: gh-stack-wrong-trunk-recovery
evals.prompt: This published gh stack was initialized with origin/main as its trunk. Repair it without replacing the PRs.
evals.expected_output: Rejects origin/main as a remote-tracking trunk, snapshots PR identities and stack state, halts for merged, queued, auto-merge-enabled, or non-open PRs, and otherwise un-stacks and re-adopts the same branches on main before verifying the same PR numbers and exact remote mapping.
